body: Workaround until w-1d8a8991b237's fix is live on the running host. After any `update … revise` on an item you hold (criteria, outcome, title), the host's binding keeps the old work revision. Later turns then go uncaptured or refuse, done refuses `unconfirmed_declaration`, and the host shows runtime_observation_scope_changed. Fix: re-name the same source root with termal_name_source_root at the same path, end the turn, and continue on the next turn; the naming turn itself stays uncaptured. Confirmed from source on 8f544b45 by Sol-8e1f (mailbox f62b0593 #2512). Retire this memory when w-1d8a's fix is live.
